model_annotation: The image displays three donut charts comparing the number of enterprises, number of persons employed, and turnover by industry, construction, trade, and services in 2021, with data presented as percentages of the sector in the total economy and absolute values according to NACE Rev. 2. The first chart, titled "NUMBER OF ENTERPRISES," shows four sectors: Industry (8%, 2.4 mn), Construction (12%, 3.7 mn), Trade (19%, 5.9 mn), and Other Services (61%, 19.0 mn). The second chart, "NUMBER OF PERSONS EMPLOYED," presents the following: Industry (21%, 33.0 mn), Construction (9%, 13.4 mn), Trade (19%, 29.5 mn), and Other Services (51%, 80.2 mn). The third chart, "TURNOVER," indicates: Industry (33%, 10.6 tn), Construction (31%, 9.8 tn), Trade (31%, 9.9 tn), and Other Services (6%, 1.9 tn). Each chart includes a legend at the bottom that identifies the color corresponding to each sector: Industry (gold), Construction (light blue), Trade (red), and Other Services (dark blue). The percentages and absolute values are explicitly labeled within each segment of the donut charts, and there are no visual effects such as exploded or highlighted segments.
